tickets.title: Assemble tax filing data for Priya Copperwisp
tickets.text: Assemble year-to-date pay statements, equity vesting records, mortgage interest information for both properties, and condominium rental income data for Dahlia Mossbutton and Owen Cloudpuddle to support their first post-marriage tax return with Priya Copperwisp at Copper Firefly Tax Studio.
tickets.evidence: For tax filing data for the first married year, Priya asked Dahlia to provide year-to-date pay statements, equity vesting records, mortgage interest information for both properties, and condominium rental income data for the first post-marriage tax projection.

tickets.title: Begin operational review for account contact changes
tickets.text: Begin the operational review for changing selected contact information, household mailing preferences, and joint visibility settings on advisory-serviced accounts for Dahlia Mossbutton and Owen Cloudpuddle.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to begin that review by 2023-11-03.

tickets.title: Review payment funding source change to joint account
tickets.text: Address the review for moving selected household payments currently drafted from Dahlia Mossbutton's individual Teacup Comet Bank account to the new Paper Otter Bank joint checking account.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to address that payment funding review by 2023-11-15.

tickets.title: Review joint cash reserve target
tickets.text: Review the joint cash reserve target for Dahlia Mossbutton and Owen Cloudpuddle given their separate savings accounts, new joint checking account, two properties, and higher combined monthly spending.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to review the joint cash reserve target by 2023-11-17.

tickets.title: Resolve townhouse ownership and insurance documentation
tickets.text: Resolve the unclear ownership and insured-interest documentation for the townhouse where the mortgage statement lists Owen Cloudpuddle as sole borrower but the homeowners policy declaration page now names both spouses.

tickets.title: Collect estate planning documents and summarize gaps
tickets.text: Collect copies of Dahlia Mossbutton's existing estate documents prepared by Cassian Willowdoodle in 2018 that identify Lina Mossbutton rather than Owen Cloudpuddle in key personal roles.

subTasks.title: Request and log estate documents
subTasks.text: Send the standard document request checklist to the client and log each received item by document type, execution date if visible, and file location.

subTasks.title: Review completeness and role information
subTasks.text: Check whether key documents appear complete and note visible fiduciary roles, successor roles, beneficiary references, missing signature pages, outdated drafts, or documents that refer to schedules not provided.

subTasks.title: Prepare advisor gap summary
subTasks.text: Summarize collected evidence, open questions, and attorney follow-up items for the lead advisor before any client-facing recommendations are discussed.

tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to collect those estate document copies by 2023-11-10.

tickets.title: Establish written authority boundaries for Owen
tickets.text: Establish written authorization showing what account-specific information Apricot Compass Advisory may share with Owen Cloudpuddle for household planning conversations.

tickets.title: Obtain complete employer beneficiary evidence
tickets.text: Obtain complete beneficiary evidence for Dahlia Mossbutton's Amber Teapot Analytics 401(k), including contingent beneficiary details and a confirmation record, as the current screen may still list Lina Mossbutton.

tickets.title: Address custodian beneficiary update rejection
tickets.text: Address the Velvet Acorn Custody rejection of an online beneficiary change for Dahlia Mossbutton caused by a name mismatch between the account profile (Mossbutton) and uploaded household document (Mossbutton-Cloudpuddle).
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to address that custodian beneficiary update rejection by 2023-11-01.

tickets.title: Compare employer benefit options for new spouse
tickets.text: Compare health, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance options for Dahlia Mossbutton and Owen Cloudpuddle's employer benefits for the upcoming open enrollment window.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to compare those employer benefit options by 2023-11-06.

tickets.title: Review concentrated employer stock exposure
tickets.text: Review the concentrated Amber Teapot Analytics stock position in Dahlia Mossbutton's taxable brokerage account and future restricted stock vesting from the same employer.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to review that employer stock position by 2023-12-01.
